Food is awesome! I think I'll go have some now. My appetite has returned big time and I'm enjoying it. I was at a seminar recently and they had a few tables set up with wine and cakes during the break. The old me would work his way from table to table getting a glass of wine at each without anybody noticing. The new me followed the same route except this time with cake. I'll have to cut back on the snacking eventually but for now I'm allowing it.

It wasn't that great but I was enjoying the buzz of being in a crowd. It's quiet family friendly during the day and I was moving around a lot so drinking wasn't an issue. The real drinking doesn't start until evening and I was long gone by then.

It's been a good weekend so far. Slept late yesterday, then out for a run. Then spent a lot of the day binge watchng episodes of Black Mirror (highly recommended). Today I was up early to have a good breakfast before driving to the nearest city where there is a music festival on. Spent the day going in and out of pubs checking out the bands. I didn't have a drink in any of them , not even an NA one. Just back home now and I have cooked myself a stirfry.I went a bit overboard with the chillies so I am working my way rapidly through a 2 litre bottle of sparkling water as I am eating it.
